source: USGS National Water Information System daily mean discharge, parameter 00060, statistic 00003
design: Only A upstream rows were seen during feasibility. B stations, dates, and evaluation criteria were fixed before obtaining B. Treat the 25% per-station worst-case tolerance as an explicit stress scenario, not as an empirically calibrated USGS uncertainty estimate. Approved daily means only; exclude missing, non-approved or ambiguous observations. Both fixed windows avoid DST transitions. No extrapolation across missing dates; count volume using elapsed seconds and the reported daily means. The same paper study or station data accessed twice is not independent confirmation.
numerical_checks: Reference computation from raw daily rows in cubic feet, converting final totals to liters. Match days exactly, volumes and signed bounds within relative 1e-9 (absolute 0.01 L for zero).
field_gates: A starts with scientific question and raw materials; investigators choose methods, routes, peer exchanges, requirements for gathering, and closure. Test actual researcher-to-researcher adoption, a durable route binding and qualified macro recipe. B is a successor with a separately acquired observation and no method/recipe names in the question. Count a changed judgment only if adopted after delivery of B's own result. Inspect original native events, report raw attempts whether or not the model chooses all mechanisms.
